# Legacy backup fixture

`backup-v1.bin` was created with the original AquariumLog implementation at
commit `33058c7`, before the PDF and capture-data migration.
`backup-v1.json` contains its plaintext data for compatibility assertions.
The password is `AquariumLog Testpasswort`.

Only synthetic test data and `assets/synthetic-photo.jpg` are included.
There are no private photos, credentials or user records.
